technical.summary: INVH shows short-term bullish momentum with golden cross and new highs, but overbought oscillators, negative CMF, and Ichimoku cloud positioning create meaningful pullback risk; moderate confluence strength limits swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: INVH shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 41 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market in fear state (43 Fear/Greed, 49.8% bearish) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but absence of recent news data and stale congressional trades (497+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (418.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring real estate valuations, FOMC event just passed, and earnings binary 41 days out create hostile trading environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross, new 10-day highs, and price above 200-EMA create short-term bullish structure with fear-zone contrarian opportunity as macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch 88.34, Williams %R, StochRSI), negative CMF, price below Ichimoku cloud, weak ADX (21.12), VIX crisis levels, and earnings binary in 41 days create excessive pullback/reversal risk that outweighs technical setup strength.

decision.primary_risk: Overbought momentum exhaustion combined with VIX crisis levels and earnings event in 41 days creates high probability of sharp pullback or gap reversal before any meaningful upside capture.
